title: Look up a member's savings balance (green screen)
description: On the core system's terminal: searches for a member by member number and returns the member's name and the current balance of their savings account.
goal: Sign on, look up member {{inputs.memberId}}, and read the member's name and current savings balance.

probes.why: a member number that doesn't exist
a member number the application rejects as malformed
a member the operator may not view
